newsitem.title: USA: Katy buys Pentland's Woods unit.
newsitem.headline: Katy buys Pentland's Woods unit.

text.p: Katy Industries Inc said on Monday that it has completed the acquisition of Woods Industries Inc from Pentland Group Plc for an estimated purchase price of $46.8 million.
The purchase price, which is below Woods' book value of net assets, is based on a projected balance sheet at November 30, 1996, Katy said.
Woods, based in Indianapolis, Indiana, is a manufacturer and distributor of electrical products with annual sales of more than $150 million and operating profits topping $5 million, Katy said.
Katy said the acquisition allows for "immediate earnings accretion."
"Woods fits very well with our electronics distribution businesses and our businesses which serve the hardware, paint-sundries and do-it-yourself markets," the company said in a statement.
